_doc: Larkspur Exploration Adit props: the Corvane Mining Co.'s small hard-rock exploration mine (1950s-80s equipment, abandoned during the quarantine) and the limestone cave its drifts broke into. Underground levels use the kit's rock finishes (walls rock_drift / rock_limestone, floors rock_floor / cave_mud; ceilings take the wall names). Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_mine.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb. size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z), measured from the clean model; footprints are centred on the origin (bottom centre), except mine_safety_board (wall-mounted: origin on the wall plane) and mine_lamp_string (ceiling-mounted: origin on the ceiling plane, hangs down). Each model also ships per-part -convcolonly collision boxes.

defs.name: Timber Drift Set
defs.description: Two battered square posts and a cap across a drift, lagging boards over the cap and stood behind the posts against the rock, wedges driven up to the back.
defs._placement: 3.0 m wide x 2.8 m tall x ~0.4 m deep, free-standing across a 3-cell drift every 2-3 m (posts ~8 cm into the side walls). collision 'none': the POI builder's box-from-size stand-in would close the drift; the model's own -convcolonly boxes are on the posts only (destroyed: one low box over the debris).

defs.name: Mine Rail
defs.description: Three metres of 0.6 m gauge light rail spiked to creosoted sleepers bedded in ballast.
defs._placement: Runs along x (prop-local), ends exactly at x +-1.5: butt pieces end to end. Rail tops at y 0.095 (mine_ore_cart's wheels rest there at the same origin). No collision: walk over it.

defs.name: Side-Tip Ore Car
defs.description: A small side-tipping ore car: a U-shaped steel tub on rockers over a channel frame, flanged wheels, timber bumpers, number 17 stencilled on its side.
defs._placement: Runs along x like mine_rail_straight; its wheels sit on rail tops (0.095 m): place it on a rail at the same origin and rotation, or with y -0.095 on bare floor. Worn: loaded with ore. Destroyed: tipped on its side, the load spilled.

defs.name: Mine Hoist
defs.description: An electric single-drum hoist on timber skids: rope wound on the drum, band brake and weighted lever, a geared motor, the operator's lever and depth dial.

defs.name: Headframe
defs.description: A red-oxide steel A-frame headframe over the shaft collar: four-post tower, backstays, the sheave wheel on its deck nine metres up, a ladder and the LARKSPUR No. 1 SHAFT sign.
defs._placement: Exterior landmark over the No. 1 shaft (the collar's opening shows a black drop: stand it where no floor is drawn over it, or accept the void panel at 2 cm). Over 8 m extent: PoiManager never draw-distance culls it. The backstays reach +z (prop-local back): face the hoist house behind it. collision 'mesh': its box-from-size stand-in would enclose the collar and cage landing; place it with the model's own collision boxes (collar, legs, deck).

defs.name: Shaft Cage
defs.description: The shaft's man cage: a steel frame with sheet and wire-mesh sides, a bridle and rope socket on the roof, guide shoes, a scissor gate folded back across the open front.
defs._placement: Open front +z. collision 'mesh': the model has floor, side, back and roof boxes so a player can step in; the box-from-size stand-in would fill it.

defs.name: Rock Face
defs.description: A blasted granite face, chunky and faceted, with fallen blocks at its foot.
defs._placement: Stand against a kit wall ('against') to break the 1 m grid: the back is flat at the wall, the outline ragged; 2.8 m tall to the ceiling.

defs.name: Rock Face (Ledge)
defs.description: A granite face with an overhanging ledge over a recess.

defs.name: Flowstone Wall
defs.description: A rounded limestone cave wall draped in flowstone, small stalagmites at its foot.
defs._placement: As mine_rock_face; matches the rock_limestone wall finish.

defs.name: Rock Fall
defs.description: A mound of broken rock and boulders where the back came down.

defs.name: Stalagmites
defs.description: A cluster of limestone stalagmites rising from a flowstone boss.

defs.name: Drift Lights
defs.description: A string of caged bulbs on a sagging cable hooked to the back of the drift.
defs._placement: ceiling_mounted: origin on the ceiling plane, 3 m along x; light at the middle bulb (place lit: true where the mine generator runs).

defs.name: Explosives Box
defs.description: A wooden box stencilled HIGH EXPLOSIVES - DANGEROUS, 50 LBS DYNAMITE on the ends.

defs.name: Tool Rack
defs.description: A timber rack of picks hung by their heads, shovels in the trough and a bundle of drill steels.

defs.name: Check Board
defs.description: The shift boss's board: a SAFETY FIRST notice, the chalk shift tally and the brass check tags of the men on shift. Some tags are missing: they never came up.
defs._placement: wall_mounted: origin on the wall plane at the board's bottom centre; hang with height ~0.9.
